sources.title: Ray Kurzweil: Universal basic income will arrive in the 2030s

sourceCaveat: Claims are shown as paraphrases unless identified as a verified quotation.

reference.criterion: Unconditional basic income operates generally across developed economies, not just a local trial.
reference.rationale: Early 2030s remains future; use 2033 as an explicit reference endpoint. Pilots and limited programs do not constitute the cross-economy rollout. Attribution rests on contemporaneous reporting rather than a located full primary transcript.

evidence.title: Ray Kurzweil: Universal basic income will arrive in the 2030s
evidence.note: Secondary, contemporaneous attribution of a TED appearance. Original event transcript was not obtained; lower attribution confidence. Not used as technical outcome evidence..
